topicTitle: 11.3 Industrial Applications of Carboxylic Acids and Esters
keyPoints: Carboxylic acids feature in food preservation, cleaning products and industrial synthesis.
Esters contribute fragrance and flavour to foods, cosmetics and perfumes, and serve as solvents.
Together they underpin many everyday consumer products, from vinegar to perfumed soaps to medicines.
stem: Evaluate the impact of carboxylic acids and esters on daily life.

keyPoints: Carboxylic acids such as ethanoic (acetic) acid lower pH, creating an environment hostile to spoilage microbes.
Vinegar (dilute ethanoic acid) is widely used to pickle and preserve foods like vegetables.
Other carboxylic acids (e.g. citric, benzoic) are used as food preservatives and flavourings.
stem: Describe how carboxylic acids are used in the food industry, particularly in food preservation.

keyPoints: Esters have pleasant fragrances and are used as scent components in perfumes, lotions and cosmetics.
In pharmaceuticals, esters serve as solvents and as active ingredients (e.g. aspirin is an ester).
Their volatility and stability make them useful carriers for delivering active compounds.
stem: Explain the use of esters in the cosmetics industry and pharmaceutical industry.
